source.ice: NOAA GLERL / CoastWatch Great Lakes Node ERDDAP GL_Ice_Concentration_GCS (GLSEA + NIC analysis), daily, percent
source.sst: NOAA GLERL / CoastWatch Great Lakes Node ERDDAP GLSEA_ACSPO_GCS (ACSPO GLSEA), daily, degC
source.lakewide: NOAA GLERL lake-average ice concentration, g<year>_<year+1>_ice.dat
source.weather: ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus / ECMWF) via Open-Meteo archive API, one point per region

variant.note: Three seconds per day (~11.4 minutes), also cut into four movements at the ice-defined days: freeze-up, ice-in, long melt, open water.
